SECURE YOUR TICKETS TO THE CHAMPIONSHIP GAME TODAY! BOOK NOW The Biggest Event in International Baseball is Back! The World Baseball Classic™ is the only tournament where the world’s top players step away from their pro teams to compete for their home countries. With national pride on the line, the energy is louder, the stakes are higher, and every game feels like a once-in-a lifetime event. HIGHLIGHTED GAMES Miami Championship March 17th, 8:00PM EST BOOK NOW Secure Your Spot at the 2026 World Baseball Classic™ Today! Official hospitality and travel packages are now available! Choose from a range of premium seating options, hotel stays, and exclusive fan experiences designed to elevate your game day. Whether you’re traveling from near or far, now is the time to lock in your place and be part of the action. Availability is limited so don’t miss your chance!
